sections.heading: Asian Market Performance
paragraphs: According to Jornal de Negócios, Asian markets closed their session higher. The Japanese company Recruit Holdings reportedly surged by 23%.
TradingKey also reported that stocks in Japan and South Korea closed higher.

sections.heading: Nikkei 225 Fluctuations
paragraphs: There are differing reports on the Nikkei 225 index. TradingKey stated that the Nikkei 225 rose by more than 2%.
However, Radio Shiga reported that the Nikkei 225 retreated due to profit taking in Japan.

sections.heading: Tech Stock Activity
paragraphs: TradingKey noted that while the broader markets rose, Samsung and SK Hynix retreated.
